title: POOR PACKAGING.
text: POOR PACKAGING.. My wife wanted to give this set of candles as a small gift. The candles have a great color & nice fragrance but, the packaging is poor. Some of the candles were chipped...could see the candle flakes inside the package, and some of the small candle tins were dented. Candles will not be given as a gift!  If you're not giving this set of candles as a gift, then order. We will keep this set & enjoy the fragrance.
